verdict.rationale: Kintsugi docs explicitly describe classifying every product into a category and subcategory that determine jurisdictional taxation (kintsugi-docs-8), backed by tax estimate and transaction sync APIs that carry per-line-item product classification (kintsugi-docs-9, kintsugi-docs-19). This directly matches the story of mapping catalog items to tax categories for correct per-jurisdiction taxation. Missing for 10: explicit enumeration of category types like SaaS/digital goods/services/physical goods, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
